title: Paneer Butter Masala
ingredients: paneer, butter, tomato, cashew, cream, garam masala, onion, garlic, ginger
instructions: 1. Saute onion, garlic, ginger. 2. Add tomato puree and cashew paste, cook till thick. 3. Add paneer cubes and cream. 4. Simmer with garam masala and serve hot.

title: Vegan Chickpea Salad
ingredients: chickpeas, cucumber, tomato, red onion, lemon, olive oil, parsley
instructions: 1. Drain and rinse chickpeas. 2. Chop cucumber, tomato, onion. 3. Toss with lemon juice, olive oil, parsley and salt.

title: Classic Margherita Pizza
ingredients: pizza dough, tomato sauce, mozzarella, basil, olive oil
instructions: 1. Roll out dough. 2. Spread tomato sauce. 3. Top with mozzarella and basil. 4. Bake at high heat until crust is golden.

title: Grilled Chicken Breast
ingredients: chicken breast, olive oil, garlic, paprika, lemon, black pepper
instructions: 1. Marinate chicken with olive oil, garlic, paprika, lemon. 2. Grill on medium-high heat 6-7 minutes per side. 3. Rest and serve.

title: Egg Fried Rice
ingredients: rice, egg, soy sauce, spring onion, garlic, carrot, peas, sesame oil
instructions: 1. Scramble eggs and set aside. 2. Saute garlic, carrot, peas. 3. Add rice and soy sauce. 4. Mix in eggs and spring onion.

title: Vegan Lentil Soup
ingredients: lentils, carrot, celery, onion, garlic, vegetable broth, cumin, turmeric
instructions: 1. Saute onion, garlic, carrot, celery. 2. Add lentils, broth, cumin, turmeric. 3. Simmer 25 minutes until lentils are soft. 4. Blend partially for texture.

title: Keto Avocado Egg Bowl
ingredients: avocado, egg, cherry tomato, olive oil, salt, pepper, chili flakes
instructions: 1. Halve avocado, remove pit. 2. Crack egg into avocado hollow. 3. Bake at 200C for 12-15 min. 4. Top with tomato and chili flakes.

title: Vegetable Stir Fry
ingredients: broccoli, bell pepper, carrot, soy sauce, garlic, ginger, sesame oil, tofu
instructions: 1. Heat sesame oil, saute garlic and ginger. 2. Add vegetables and tofu. 3. Stir fry on high heat 5-7 min. 4. Add soy sauce and toss.

title: Beef Tacos
ingredients: ground beef, taco shells, lettuce, tomato, cheese, onion, cumin, chili powder
instructions: 1. Cook beef with cumin and chili powder. 2. Fill taco shells with beef. 3. Top with lettuce, tomato, cheese, onion.

title: Masala Dosa
ingredients: rice batter, urad dal batter, potato, onion, mustard seeds, curry leaves, turmeric
instructions: 1. Spread batter thin on hot griddle. 2. Prepare potato masala with onion, mustard seeds, turmeric. 3. Fill dosa with masala and fold.

title: Vegan Buddha Bowl
ingredients: quinoa, chickpeas, kale, sweet potato, avocado, tahini, lemon
instructions: 1. Roast sweet potato and chickpeas. 2. Cook quinoa. 3. Assemble bowl with kale, avocado. 4. Drizzle tahini-lemon dressing.

title: Shrimp Garlic Pasta
ingredients: shrimp, spaghetti, garlic, olive oil, chili flakes, parsley, lemon
instructions: 1. Cook pasta. 2. Saute garlic and shrimp in olive oil with chili flakes. 3. Toss pasta with shrimp, parsley, lemon juice.

title: Chana Masala
ingredients: chickpeas, tomato, onion, garlic, ginger, garam masala, cumin, coriander
instructions: 1. Saute onion, garlic, ginger. 2. Add tomato and spices, cook till thick. 3. Add chickpeas and simmer 15 minutes.

title: Keto Salmon with Asparagus
ingredients: salmon, asparagus, butter, garlic, lemon, black pepper
instructions: 1. Season salmon with salt, pepper. 2. Pan sear salmon in butter. 3. Saute asparagus with garlic. 4. Serve with lemon wedge.

title: Vegetable Biryani
ingredients: basmati rice, carrot, peas, beans, potato, yogurt, biryani masala, onion, mint
instructions: 1. Fry onions till golden. 2. Cook vegetables with yogurt and biryani masala. 3. Layer with partially cooked rice. 4. Dum cook 20 minutes.

title: Sambar
ingredients: toor dal, tamarind, drumstick, carrot, tomato, onion, sambar powder, mustard seeds, curry leaves
instructions: 1. Pressure cook toor dal until soft. 2. Cook vegetables with tomato and tamarind water. 3. Add dal and sambar powder, then simmer. 4. Temper mustard seeds and curry leaves in oil and mix in.

title: Rasam
ingredients: tomato, tamarind, rasam powder, garlic, cumin, pepper, coriander, curry leaves
instructions: 1. Boil tomatoes with tamarind water and spices. 2. Mash the tomatoes and add rasam powder. 3. Simmer until fragrant without boiling hard. 4. Temper garlic, cumin and curry leaves, then garnish with coriander.

title: Idli
ingredients: idli rice, urad dal, salt, water
instructions: 1. Soak rice and urad dal separately. 2. Grind and ferment the batter overnight. 3. Pour batter into greased idli moulds. 4. Steam for 10-12 minutes and serve with sambar or chutney.

title: Coconut Chutney
ingredients: fresh coconut, roasted gram, green chili, ginger, salt, mustard seeds, curry leaves
instructions: 1. Blend coconut, roasted gram, chili, ginger and salt with water. 2. Transfer to a bowl. 3. Temper mustard seeds and curry leaves in hot oil. 4. Pour the tempering over the chutney and mix.

title: Poriyal
ingredients: beans, carrot, grated coconut, mustard seeds, urad dal, curry leaves, turmeric
instructions: 1. Heat oil and temper mustard seeds, urad dal and curry leaves. 2. Add chopped beans and carrot with turmeric and salt. 3. Cover and cook until tender. 4. Finish with grated coconut and serve as a side dish.

title: Curd Rice
ingredients: cooked rice, yogurt, milk, ginger, green chili, mustard seeds, curry leaves, coriander
instructions: 1. Mash cooked rice while warm and cool it. 2. Mix in yogurt, milk, ginger and salt. 3. Temper mustard seeds, chili and curry leaves in oil. 4. Stir into the rice and garnish with coriander.

title: Avial
ingredients: mixed vegetables, coconut, yogurt, cumin, green chili, curry leaves, coconut oil
instructions: 1. Cook mixed vegetables with turmeric and a little water. 2. Grind coconut, cumin and green chili into a paste. 3. Stir the paste into the vegetables. 4. Turn off the heat, fold in yogurt and finish with coconut oil and curry leaves.

title: Medu Vada
ingredients: urad dal, onion, green chili, ginger, curry leaves, black pepper, oil
instructions: 1. Soak urad dal and grind it into a thick fluffy batter. 2. Mix in onion, chili, ginger, curry leaves and pepper. 3. Shape into rings with wet hands. 4. Deep fry until golden and serve hot.

title: Lemon Rice
ingredients: cooked rice, lemon, peanuts, mustard seeds, chana dal, turmeric, green chili, curry leaves
instructions: 1. Heat oil and temper mustard seeds, chana dal, peanuts and curry leaves. 2. Add chili and turmeric. 3. Fold in cooked rice and salt. 4. Turn off the heat, add lemon juice and mix gently.
